newsitem.title: USA: More US corporate bond issues coming, demand good.
newsitem.headline: More US corporate bond issues coming, demand good.

text.p: NEW YORK, Oct 24 - Corporate bond issuers lured by attractive financing levels continue to bring debt to market with much success as hungry investors meet the new supply with good demand, dealers said.
"A number of deals are expected this week...the paper continues to meet with very good demand," one syndicate source said.

So far on Thursday, Associates Corp of North America priced $600 million in five-year bonds to yield 40 basis points over Treasuries. The deal was jointly managed by Goldman Sachs International and Lehman Brothers International.
"The market has retained its positive tone so issuers should continue to capitalize on this ideal environment and issue debt at cheaper levels," said another syndicate source.

Banc One will price its $500 million in A1/A-plus rated 30-year subordinated bank debt on Thursday via CS First Boston. Price talk is seen between 76 and 79 basis points over Treasuries, sources said.
Falconbridge Limited is also on tap to bring debt to market with $250 million of a 10-year bullet deal via Goldman Sachs & Co, dealers said.

Mirage Resorts is expected to price $200 million of a 10-year bullet as early as Thursday via Goldman Sachs and CS First Boston. Mirage's debt is of particular interest, dealers said, because the company's credit has moved from junk status to investment grade.
Meanwhile, ABN Amro's $500 million five-year subordinated debt deal, which priced to yield 40 basis points over Treasuriees, was met with very strong demand, dealers said.
However, CIT Group Holdings new 6.25 percent notes widend 10 basis points on the break. Traders said the issue was priced too agressively.
The calendar for 144A private placement issues continues to grow with a long list of issues scheduled to hit the market, dealers said.
Parker Drilling is expected to issue $275 million in 144A senior notes.
Abraxas Petroleum Corp is expected to price $200 million in 144A notes due 2004.
FSW International Finance is also expected to issue $135 million in 144A guaranteed senior secured notes.
Unison Healthcare Corp is expected to price $100 million in 144A senior subordinated notes due 2006, dealers said.
Unifrax Corp may also price $100 million in seven-year notes. Price talk on the issue is 10.25 to 10.50 percent, dealers said.
Among other upcoming issues, Nationale Bank de Paris is expected to tap the market with about $500 million in debt in early November, sources added.
